description: Semrush CLI with Domain Overview, organic keyword research, and backlink intelligence — JSON-first, agent-native, with a local SQLite cache for offline use.

novel_features.name: Magic-recipe keyword research
novel_features.description: Run a full keyword research pass — seeds expand via the Keyword Magic Tool, filter by Personal Keyword Difficulty against your client domain, score by intent + volume + opportunity, dedupe across seeds, and emit a ready-for-Sheets ranked list.

novel_features.name: Keyword Magic Tool with PKD
novel_features.description: Run the Keyword Magic Tool against a seed and get Personal Keyword Difficulty (PKD) scored against your target domain. PKD is not exposed by the public Analytics API.

novel_features.name: Push results to a Google Sheets client template
novel_features.description: Push Semrush data (keyword research, rankings, gap analysis) directly into your existing Google Sheets client template — no copy/paste, no CSV roundtrip.

novel_features.name: Add keywords to Position Tracking with tags
novel_features.description: Add one or more keywords to a Semrush Position Tracking campaign, optionally tagging them so they show up grouped in the PT UI. The public Semrush API does not expose Position Tracking write endpoints.

novel_features.name: Pull current organic rankings for a tracked campaign
novel_features.description: Returns the current organic rankings snapshot for every tracked keyword in a Position Tracking campaign — position, position diff, volume, SERP features, traffic estimate. Different from `pt report` which returns rank history.

novel_features.name: Annotate a Position Tracking campaign
novel_features.description: Add an annotation (note) to a Position Tracking campaign — appears on the PT chart at the specified date. Lets you correlate site changes (publishes, redirects, algorithm updates) with ranking movements.
